TEMP-A.name: PIXEL MEDOID
TEMP-A.pixelDistance: L1 sum of absolute RGB differences on 270x270 source ROI

TEMP-B.name: PIXELWISE TEMPORAL MEDIAN
TEMP-B.operation: per-pixel per-RGB-channel median across all valid 270x270 frames; exact uint8 median for odd frame count

TEMP-C.name: MAJORITY SPATIAL CANDIDATE CONSENSUS
TEMP-C.clustering: undirected connected components over unchanged-production finalist locations with an edge for Euclidean z5 distance <= 96

TEMP-D.name: GT-BLIND TEMPORAL EVIDENCE MEDIAN
TEMP-D.clusterSource: same fixed spatial clusters as TEMP-C
TEMP-D.perFrameDedup: within a cluster retain the candidate with highest original combined; ties by scale-aware then x then y

evaluationFreeze.wrongBasinDefinition: candidate center farther than 60 z5 px from known GT

survivorRule.improvement: correct-vs-wrong combined margin delta >= 0.01 against raw center frame
survivorRule.noMaterialRegression: no known-GT control margin worsens by more than 0.02

evaluationFreeze.stressRule: run exact 40-frame GFN stress only for one method satisfying survivorRule; if multiple survive, choose highest improved-control count, then median margin delta, then fixed order TEMP-A,TEMP-B,TEMP-C,TEMP-D

generalClassification.G-STABLE-LOW: all valid nearby raw frames remain below 0.58 and no common temporal method satisfies survivorRule
generalClassification.G-MIXED: valid nearby raw frames cross 0.58 or materially oscillate in matcher state without a shared survivor
generalClassification.G-TEMPORAL-RECOVERABLE: a shared temporal method satisfies survivorRule and stabilizes General with correct-preferred evidence

antiOverfit: no frame selected by GT score
